recentItems.title: Messi shaped schnitzel?! 🍗🇦🇷 Argentina restaurant cooks up Messi tribute
recentItems.description:
An Argentine restaurant is paying tribute to Lionel Messi with a milanesa shaped like the football star's face.

The “Milamessi” was created after Messi announced his retirement from international football.

recentItems.title: Why is North Korea so good at women's youth football?
recentItems.description: North Korea dominates women's youth football. Its under 20s are defending world champions and its under 17s have won back-to-back titles. What's behind their success?

recentItems.title: Ebnoutalib: Hat trick hero for Frankfurt
recentItems.description:
Two years ago Younes Ebnoutalib played in Germany's 4th division. On Bundesliga MD1 he scored a hat trick for Frankfurt. 💪🇩🇪😮

The 22-year-old played for Morocco at youth level but is still eligible to represent Germany. Klopp call incoming? ⏳

recentItems.title: Boring Bundesliga? Why are fans still going?
recentItems.description: Bayern always winning, the league losing talents like Haaland and Bellingham. What makes the Bundesliga actually enjoyable? Why do fans keep going? #shorts #bundesliga

recentItems.title: Concerns over Jamal Musiala's seizures?😳
recentItems.description:
Germany star Jamal Musiala collapsed twice in two games due to what Bayern described as a "neurological dysfunction."

No full diagnosis has been revealed, but he has been ruled out of Bayern's Super Cup clash against Borussia Dortmund. 🚨

recentItems.title: Cameroon celebrates WAFCON glory!
recentItems.description:
Celebrations swept Cameroon's capital Yaoundé as the country welcomed their Women’s African Cup of Nations winners 🇨🇲🏆

Cameroon's 3-0 victory over Malawi earned them their first ever WAFCON title!
